definitions.explanation: Discussions related to business deals or transactions.

examples.japanese: {商談|しょうだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まとまった→まとまる：01642_matomaru⟧。
{商談|しょうだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}む→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧。
{商談|しょうだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}した→成立：04353_seiritsu⟧。

notes:
{商談|しょうだん} refers to business negotiations or discussions, especially in B2B contexts.

FORMS:
⟦{商|しょう}→商：noentry⟧ (commerce) + ⟦{談|だん}→談：noentry⟧ (talk/discussion)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {商談|しょうだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まとまる→まとまる：01642_matomaru⟧: deal comes together
- {商談|しょうだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}する→成立：04353_seiritsu⟧: deal is concluded
- {商談|しょうだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}む→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧: to engage in negotiations
- {商談|しょうだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧: to advance negotiations

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧: negotiation (general)
- ⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧: transaction, deal
- ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧: contract

{商談|しょうだん} specifically implies business-related negotiations, while ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧ is broader and can apply to any type of negotiation.
